description: Use when you want cross-sectional residual statistics for SPY and the 11 GICS sector SPDR cohorts, on one date or as a time series. Not for one stock's peers (use riskmodels_get_peers) or one stock's rank (use riskmodels_get_rankings). Returns, from GET /cohorts (one date) or GET /cohorts/series (series=true), residual_mean, residual_sd, mean_pairwise_corr, n_names and n_effective by default, more on request. ERM3 residuals are fitted without an intercept, so residual_mean is not zero; link_fit_resid_sd is the residual standard deviation of the 252-day link regression, a fit-quality measure rather than a standard error. Subsector cohorts are not available. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.04 for one date, $0.15 for a series.

cohorts.description: Comma-separated cohort tickers from SPY, XLE, XLB, XLI, XLY, XLP, XLV, XLF, XLK, XLC, XLU, XLRE, e.g. "SPY,XLK" (default all)

end_date.description: Series end, series=true only, format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-06-30

min_names.description: Drop cohorts or days with fewer members, integer, e.g. 20

series.description: true returns a time series over start_date..end_date, e.g. true (default false: one date)

start_date.description: Series start, series=true only, format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2025-01-02

teo.description: Observation date for the one-date view (default latest), format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-06-30

variables.description: Comma-separated variables, e.g. "residual_sd,n_names" (default residual_mean, residual_sd, mean_pairwise_corr, n_names, n_effective)

name: riskmodels_get_cohorts
title: RiskModels Cohort Statistics
